TEXT.English:
An old technique by the priests of Lugus, from before the age of ice, involved leaving an enchanted refractive lantern with its hinge open and facing the sun. This would capture a small bit of the radiance of Lugus, and the sun god's grace would be with you even in the most dismal of domains.
This skill is lost now, but these little glowing lanterns remain as a testament to the achievements of the age of magic.

TEXT.English:
Your unit enters a room covered in ritualistic markings, and a low chanting sound fills the air.
In the far corner, your unit sees a coven of hooded figures kneeling and kissing the ground in front of what appears to be a succubus with an angel's severed wings worn about their waist like a dress.
Noticing you, the succubus beckons, "Come to worship the angel of love?" she cackles, before drawing a dark, jagged blade.
